title: Study Manager – Upstream Facilities
jobDescription:
Job Title: Study Manager – Upstream Facilities About Technip Energies: A global technology and engineering powerhouse leading in energy and decarbonization infrastructure. Technip Energies is a global engineering and technology leader, delivering some of the world’s largest and most complex engineering and construction projects. With strong leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO₂ management, we actively support the development of critical markets including energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our three complementary Business Units
- Project Delivery & Services (PD&S), Technologies & Products (T&P), and Adjacent Business Models (ABM) transforming innovation into scalable, industrial solutions. To know more, visit: Technip Energies at a glance
- Technip Energies at a glance | Technip Energies Position Overview: We are currently seeking a Study Manager – Upstream Facilities, reporting directly to HOD – Genesis to join our Genesis team based in Mumbai/ Noida. Company information: Genesis is a market-leading consulting company focused on providing high-value advisory services for the energy industry. As trusted advisors committed to a sustainable future, we have extensive experience working in true partnership with our clients while providing innovative, robust and sustainable solutions for over 35 years. Genesis is a global business unit of Technip Energies, providing impartial consulting services to its clients in traditional hydrocarbon and the energy industries. We have an unrivalled track record of bringing high-impact solutions to clients. Our mission is to be a trusted advisor on the journey to a sustainable future. We are problem solvers who are at the forefront of innovation and our world-class experience, individual expertise and collective wisdom is what differentiates Genesis in today’s market. From Engineers and Specialists to Project Managers and Support Staff, spread across 13 countries, our people thrive in a dynamic, proactive business that is balanced with a deep sense of environmental responsibility. We see limitless possibilities for our solutions; and our knowledge sharing, collaboration and innovative thinking are just a few of the ways we fuel our energy for what we do. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
We are seeking an experienced professional to oversee and manage the responsibilities below. The Upstream Facilities Study Manager is responsible for leading and delivering multi-disciplinary upstream facilities studies including feasibility, conceptual, pre-FEED and front-end advisory scopes. The role ensures technical excellence, safe and efficient study execution, quality delivery, Client relationship management skills and strong commercial stewardship. The Upstream Facilities Study Manager shall work within a study team or lead smaller studies, interfacing with the wider Genesis organisation both locally and globally. They shall provide facilities technical inputs and project engineering on a variety of front end studies and bespoke operations support/troubleshooting for clients globally. The position requires a self-starter who can flexibly manage and deliver on multiple priorities. A high level of commitment is required together with a willingness to take responsibility and take on new challenges. In return, the position will provide the opportunity to join a successful and dynamic team and extensive opportunities for professional and personal growth. Main Accountabilities: Lead and oversee Upstream Facilities Engineering input into studies, providing technical guidance and strategic direction. Manage multi-disciplinary design teams to deliver early-phase studies on time, within scope, and to quality standards. Ensure compliance with applicable engineering standards, codes, and management of change processes throughout design and execution phases. Monitor project and study progress, track deliverables, and assist in preparing management reports to support decision-making. Collaborate closely with client personnel and Genesis engineering specialists to ensure project compliance, quality, and alignment with Genesis standards. Prepare clear, comprehensive study reports and presentations that effectively communicate findings and recommendations. Develop integrated study plans aligned with asset planning and business objectives, facilitating effective communication of facilities engineering activities both onshore and offshore. Lead project meetings, coordinate activities, and manage study performance to ensure objectives are met efficiently. Participate in design reviews, construction planning, HAZID/HAZOP sessions, and technical impact assessments to ensure safety and technical integrity. Develop innovative, cost-effective technical solutions using the latest industry design criteria and best practices. Interface with third-party engineering consultants and contractors, providing technical guidance and ensuring deliverables meet project standards. Collaborate with tendering teams to develop high-quality proposals and bid submissions in response to client inquiries. Drive continuous improvement initiatives by developing and implementing best practices, work processes, and tools, incorporating lessons learned to enhance project delivery. The above is an outline of key duties and accountabilities, rather than an exclusive or exhaustive list of responsibilities. The post holder is expected to undertake any tasks which may reasonably be expected within the scope of the position. Required Skills and Experience: Languages: English (Fluent) Main skills: Degree qualified or with significant experience working in the oil and gas industry or similar industry Previous experience of working as part of and leading a multi-discipline team on facilities engineering studies / projects in the Upstream Industry Proven experience in developing solutions for greenfield and brownfield project environments, incorporating installation and constructability assessments Proven experience in brownfield modifications and debottlenecking studies Competence in supporting the development of cost and schedule estimates Exposure to and understanding of oil and gas Operator value drivers and stage gate project delivery processes Detailed knowledge of relevant international standards, Client and project specific standards Able to work independently and within integrated local and virtual teams Current offshore survival and medical certificates desired but not essential Flexibility for ad-hoc travel both within India and abroad Strong personal values and willing to take clear personal accountability for actions Demonstrated verbal and written communication and presentation skills. This requires the ability to articulate in a clear, concise and constructive manner at the appropriate level for the intended audience Produces work of accurate and presentable quality in the appropriate formats Good organizational skills, SMART working methods and can demonstrate personal effectiveness in previous roles Comfortable working with a variety of teams and parts of the organization Self-motivated and able to deliver in a goal orientated working environment Offshore experience preferred Experience in an operations or engineering project role preferred Experience in asset life extension projects preferred Experience working with FPSOs and Semi-Submersible Platforms is an advantage Experience developing teams and working cross boarders essential Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor's or Master's (preferred) Degree in Engineering (Chemical/Petroleum/Mechanical), with 15-20 years of relevant industry experience. Commitment to continuous professional development (Chartered Engineer preferred) #LI-MS2 The Upstream Facilities Study Manager is responsible for leading and delivering multi-disciplinary upstream facilities studies including feasibility, conceptual, pre-FEED and front-end advisory scopes. The role ensures technical excellence, safe and efficient study execution, quality delivery, Client relationship management skills and strong commercial stewardship.

title: Resident Construction Manager
jobDescription:
Be part of the solution at Technip Energies and embark on a one-of-a-kind journey. You will be helping to develop cutting-edge solutions to solve real-world energy problems. We are currently seeking a Resident Construction Manager, to join our team, and this position will be directly reporting to Head
- Construction About us: Technip Energies is a global technology and engineering powerhouse. With leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO2 management, we are contributing to the development of critical markets such as energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our complementary business segments, Technology, Products and Services (TPS) and Project Delivery, turn innovation into scalable and industrial reality. Through collaboration and excellence in execution, our 17,000+ employees across 34 countries are fully committed to bridging prosperity with sustainability for a world designed to last. About the mission we offer you: In this role, you will work with the Project and site team ensuring the overall management of all site activities in terms of HSE, quality, cost, and milestones, in compliance with company rules and procedures, project specifications, while maintaining good relationships with client/PMC and local authorities. You will be instrumental in ensuring project completion on time. About you: We love to hear from you and how you match with this position. To be successful in this mission you should consider the following requirements: Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Elaborates the construction and sub-contracting strategy on the basis of scope of work, contract obligations, and Company policy and in line with project requirements. Participates in construction schedule on the basis of contractual milestones/targets giving input to the Project Group so as to elaborate the Overall project Master Schedule. Coordinates the preparation of Overall and Discipline Construction Progress Charts. Finalizes the Site Organization in terms of site key personnel, job descriptions and necessary qualifications and ensures coordination of the overall workforce. Manage site preparation activities at Headquarters then with the pioneer construction team Manage the construction site Acts as the TEN representatives for all relationships with local Authorities, Client, Partners, Subcontractors or Vendors linked to site activities. Ensures that Quality Management Systems and HSE&S policy is properly implemented and monitored. Surveys the situation and trends of site costs he is directly responsible for and decides internal reallocation of budgets (when no impact on overall budget allocations). Ensures timely report of any incidents to Project Manager. Make the necessary corrections to the construction strategy during execution Directly supervises (operationally): all managers working on the site Internally: Home Office Construction Department, Project Director/Project Manager, Cost control Manager. Externally: Client / PMC (Project Management Consultant), Subcontractors, Partners, authorities, banks, insurance companies, vendors. Qualifications / Skills: Bachelor’s degree/Diploma in Engineering, Mechanical or a related field. Experience with 20+Years (Bachelors)/25+Years (Diploma) of experience and handling similar role in last 5 years in EPC/EPCM/PMC Projects in Oil & Gas industry. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently. Starting Date: September 2026 Your career with us Working at Technip Energies is an inspiring journey, filled with groundbreaking projects and dynamic collaborations. Surrounded by diverse and talented individuals, you will feel welcomed, respected, and engaged. Enjoy a safe, caring environment where you can spark new ideas, reimagine the future, and lead change. As your career grows, you will benefit from learning opportunities at T.EN University, such as The Future Ready Program, Graduate Program, and from the support of your manager through check-in moments like the Mid-Year Development Review, fostering continuous growth and development. What’s Next? Once receiving your system application, our recruiting team will screen and match your skills, experience, and potential team fit against the role requirements. We ask for your patience as the team completes the volume of applications with reasonable timeframe. Check your application progress periodically via personal account from created candidate profile during your application. We invite you to get to know more about our company by visiting www.ten.com and follow us on Linked In , Instagram , Facebook , X and You Tube for company updates. In this role, you will work with the Project and site team ensuring the overall management of all site activities in terms of HSE, quality, cost, and milestones, in compliance with company rules and procedures, project specifications

title: Lead Engineer - Electrical
jobDescription:
Be part of the solution at Technip Energies and embark on a one-of-a-kind journey. You will be helping to develop cutting-edge solutions to solve real-world energy problems. We are currently seeking Lead Engineer-Electrical to join our Team, and this position will be directly reporting to HOD, Electrical for Gurugram. About us: Technip Energies is a global technology and engineering powerhouse. With leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO2 management, we are contributing to the development of critical markets such as energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our complementary business segments, Technology, Products and Services (TPS) and Project Delivery, turn innovation into scalable and industrial reality. Through collaboration and excellence in execution, our 17,000+ employees across 34 countries are fully committed to bridging prosperity with sustainability for a world designed to last. About the mission we offer you: We seek a seasoned professional to join our team as Lead Engineer-Electrical. This role is ideal for individuals with a Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering and 15-22 years of industry experience. Expertise in ETAP, SEL, and various lighting design software is crucial. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience in the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, or Fertilizer industries. As part of our team, you will lead electrical design and analysis, ensuring compliance with industry standards and project requirements. Join us in driving innovation and excellence in engineering. Qualifications / Skills: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, with at least 8-15 years of relevant industry experience. Conversant with ETAP, SEL and other Lighting software. Experience in Oil &Gas, Petrochemical, Fertilizer industries is preferred. Shall be well versed with Indian& International codes. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English is essential. Ability to foster communication within diverse cultural environments. About you: We love to hear from you and how you match with this position. To be successful in this mission you should consider the following requirements:

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Responsible for all engineering activities in one or multi discipline for specific projects in accordance with contractual requirements (design, budgeted hours, schedule etc.) by leading a team of Engineers/ Designers and by coordinating with other departments and external agencies. Main Accountabilities: Establishes Discipline OMSE plan and defines discipline objectives, team role, execution plan, surveillance plan, work process in accordance with project objectives and TEN procedures. Is responsible for performing activities and issuing deliverables in accordance with project schedule, quality, contractual requirements, and execution plan. Is responsible for establishing team organization and managing mobilization plan in accordance with budget and workforce (E bulletin) in coordination with head of department. Supervises internal/external subcontracted engineering activities as per project execution and surveillance plan. Checks on/and approves discipline deliverables. Manages and controls schedule and progress (JAMUS). Controls main/hours budget and identifies internal change request (E ICR). Identifies technical risk & opportunities to cope with project objectives in terms of cost, quality, and schedule. Consolidates & ensures awareness of input and output data for the discipline. Coordinates with other engineering process/FISE disciplines, procurement, construction, subcontract, commissioning, and project supports for the discipline’s activities. Arbitration (Engineering strategy, Contractual topic, Cost & Schedule) is by Project Engineering Manager. Identifies optimized technical/economical solutions in coordination with other disciplines. Validation (and arbitration as necessary) by Project Engineering Manager. Manages the team to ensure that all members are aware of assigned work and comply with DOMEST, objectives & TEN work process. Monitors discipline KPI. Performs reporting to Discipline Department Manager / Project management. Represses the company toward clients, partners, subcontractors, vendors, and third parties for technical subjects in his/her discipline. Support by Project Engineering Manager as necessary. Manages and controls material quantities with regards to Price sheet budget and proposed mitigation/operate actions to control the quantity increase. Ensures issuance of the MTO Report for the discipline. Supports the Discipline manager in implementation of the Digital Initiatives in the projects as required due to time. Establishes projects close out and lessons learned. Role Dimension Supervision & Management of a small team (Group Leaders, Specialist Engineers, Designers, Draftsmen) Management of one operating center and dedicated to one project Can act as Lead multi disciplines for continual and small FEED Your career with us Working at Technip Energies is an inspiring journey, filled with groundbreaking projects and dynamic collaborations. Surrounded by diverse and talented individuals, you will feel welcomed, respected, and engaged. Enjoy a safe, caring environment where you can spark new ideas, reimagine the future, and lead change. As your career grows, you will benefit from learning opportunities at T.EN University, such as The Future Ready Program, Graduate Program, and from the support of your manager through check-in moments like the Mid-Year Development Review, fostering continuous growth and development. What’s Next? Once receiving your system application, our recruiting team will screen and match your skills, experience, and potential team fit against the role requirements. We ask for your patience as the team completes the volume of applications with reasonable timeframe. Check your application progress periodically via personal account from created candidate profile during your application. We invite you to get to know more about our company by visiting www.ten.com and follow us on Linked In , Instagram , Facebook , X and You Tube for company updates. #LI-MR1 We are looking for a B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering with 8 to 15 years of experience in FEED, design, and detail engineering for LSTK/EPCM projects in Oil & Gas, Refinery, and Petrochemicals. The role requires expertise in sizing calculations, metering & protection, material requisition, substation engineering, and layout checking. Proficiency in SPEL, ETAP, AVEVA, and 3D modeling review tools like SPR or Navisworks is essential. Knowledge of IS, IES, IEE, BS, ANSI codes, and other PMC standards is required. Field engineering and commissioning experience is a plus.

title: Deputy Manager - Chart of Accounts
jobDescription:
Be part of the solution at Technip Energies and embark on a one-of-a-kind journey. You will be helping to develop cutting-edge solutions to solve real-world energy problems. We are currently seeking Deputy Manager
- Chart of Accounts , to join our Finance Design team based in Noida . About us: Technip Energies is a global technology and engineering powerhouse. With leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO2 management, we are contributing to the development of critical markets such as energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our complementary business segments, Technology, Products and Services (TPS) and Project Delivery, turn innovation into scalable and industrial reality. Through collaboration and excellence in execution, our 17,000+ employees across 34 countries are fully committed to bridging prosperity with sustainability for a world designed to last. Global Business Services India At Technip Energies, we are continually looking for ways to become more efficient, and ways to improve our quality, customer focus and cost competitiveness.
